recG4mC1e79KaK37p.Bio: Jason Quitt is a Canadian author and researcher of ancient mysticism, sacred geometry and archaeo-astronomy, and the founder of The Crystal Sun. A graduate of the Institute of Energy Wellness who has studied energy modalities, shamanism and Qi Gong since 2002, he has taught and lectured on mysticism, meditation and out of body experience since 2010. His books include Egyptian Postures of Power, The Yosef Codes, Astral Genesis, Gates of the Anunnaki and Astral Experiences. His latest, The Shining Island: Precession, Axis Mundi, & Plato's Celestial Allegory, reads Plato's Atlantis not as a sunken empire but as a celestial allegory encoding the fall of the pole star and the precession of the Great Year.
recG4mC1e79KaK37p.Name: Jason Quitt

fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Jason Quitt received the Egyptian Postures of Power from astral temples in the dream world where spiritual beings transmitted these practices to him telepathically. This conversation is the story of how that happened and what he brought back.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: Jason Quitt, mystic researcher and author of Egyptian Postures of Power, joins InnerVerse for his first appearance to share a lifetime of direct mystical experience. The conversation covers childhood past life recall and paranormal sensitivity, astral dream teachers in Egyptian, Hindu, Buddhist, and Chinese temples who transmit information telepathically, sleep paralysis as the mystical egg the soul cracks to leave the body, building the astral body through qigong and meditation to navigate the other worlds, 360-degree astral vision with a zoom function, the built-in self-healing mechanism that activates through trauma, healing by moving into pain rather than away from it, the warm honey release of a slipped disc healed through a Tesla field generator and focused intention, the shamanic dismemberment and rebuilding archetype in plant medicine journeys, Sekhmet and Bastet as the destructive and restorative poles of Egyptian healing, sacred frequency chambers in Egyptian temples, and the ren as the secret vibrational name at the heart of Egyptian magic.
fields.Title: Ancient Knowledge From Dream World Teachers with Jason Quitt | Egyptian Postures of Power
